tbesh_html:
1) one of a flock, lamb, sheep, goat, young sheep, young goat
1a) sheep, goat
1b) flock (collective)
Also means: zeh (זֶה "lamb" H2089)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat
strongs_1890.derivation: or שֵׂי; probably from H7582 (שָׁאָה) through the idea of pushing out to graze;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: (lesser, small) cattle, ewe, goat, lamb, sheep. Compare H2089 (זֶה).
